statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is in the watch band while Jackson Hole repricing is live; the muted cash open does not yet establish a persistent one-way NQ path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The active danger window remains concentrated through 15:30 UTC; a block-band Tail reading would require persistent post-event extension and failed meaningful retracements.
headline: WATCH Tail during live Jackson Hole repricing; Stress remains extreme
body: Wall Street opened nearly flat, with the Nasdaq down 0.10%, as the 14:00 UTC Jackson Hole policy impulse began. Reuters reports Kevin Warsh emphasized further work if above-target inflation persists, while verified post-speech NQ retracement structure remains incomplete.

outlookSummary: Tail is in WATCH while the Jackson Hole impulse is actively being absorbed. The next one to two hours are the main test for persistent extension versus meaningful retracement; if two-way price discovery holds, Tail is expected to return below 20 while Stress decays into the close.
